retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album layout featuring a large, grotesque cartoon character interacting with a crowd of silhouettes, paired with heavy, ultra-condensed block typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition where a large, hunched cartoon primate dominates the right side, surrounded by a rough blue chalk-like aura, while heavy stacked typography occupies the upper left, overlooking a chaotic scene of dancing silhouettes and musical notes.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the giant central figure and the tiny crowd below
Textual weight balancing the visual mass of the character
Blue textured halo separating the subject from the white background
Diagonal movement from the character's reaching hand toward the crowd
coreInvariants: Hunched, exaggerated primate anatomy with bulging eyes
Rough, sketchy ink outlines with flat or textured color fills

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large character occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to nearly full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy black block lettering in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red header, moves down through the black block text, follows the character's arm to the crowd, and circles back up the character's back.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left side behind the tracklist and around the top edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background providing high contrast for black elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary typography and character outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the top header and sky blue for the textured aura.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation accents and low-value primary subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' with a straight, vertical descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold red all-caps header paired with ultra-condensed black lowercase display and small green/black sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and verticality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s cartoon illustration of a large, hunched primate in a white tank top on a white background. Surround the character with a rough, sky-blue chalk aura. At the bottom, include a crowd of small black silhouetted figures dancing amidst scattered musical notes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a red all-caps header in the top left. Below it, add two lines of ultra-condensed black lowercase text, tightly stacked. Below that, add a list of song titles in small green and black sans-serif font, left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the main text ultra-condensed and black?
Is there a blue textured aura around the character?
Are the dancing figures at the bottom silhouetted?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the character looks like a 60s caricature, not a modern 3D render.
Check that the blue aura has a dry-brush or chalk texture.
Verify the text is stacked with almost no vertical space between lines.
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified retro tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a grotesque 60s cartoon subject + wrap in a textured blue aura + balance with ultra-condensed stacked block type in the opposite corner.
